messages:
Sam (AE): Quick sync: Photon Analytics wants a tight 10-day POC. Start hosted API keys in EU, but must be able to flip to Dedicated + VPC by day 5 if the load/policy checks out. They also asked for a short internal onboarding checklist and a billing cap.
Ivy (SE): I can run the onboarding. Need expected peak qps and whether embeddings will be enabled. Also they asked for example prompts and deterministic evals.
Sam (AE): They said ~55 rps peak, chat + later embeddings. EU-only data. Procurement wants a simple pricing note and a sample SOW for a short Dedicated eval.
Luca (Platform): Hosted quick path: spin trial org in eu-west-1 and issue an ephemeral API key. For Dedicated mid-POC: recommend 1x8 GPU with autoscale and pre-warm KV cache if they need determinism. VPC peering needs infra intake; lead time ~7-10bd.
Hana (Security): Requirements: SOC2 + EU tenancy, client-managed KMS preferred, redact PII for POC by default. I'll prepare the short security attachment and a templated answer for their questionnaire.
Ivy (SE): Short internal runbook (bullet):
- Create org photon-poc (eu-west-1) and issue ephemeral key (scope: chat,embeddings)
- Apply org billing cap $1,200 and set usage alert at 70%
- Share quickstart repo + deterministic test case (temp=0)
- If Dedicated requested, open infra ticket and schedule sizing call with Luca
- If VPC requested, collect peering CIDR and open peering intake
Luca (Platform): Internal CLI snippets:
```
rwctl org create --name "photon-poc" --region eu-west-1 --tier trial
rwctl api-keys create --org photon-poc --note "poc-ephemeral"
rwctl dedicated estimate --org photon-poc --gpus 8 --region eu-west-1
```
Ivy (SE): I'll run a smoke test against eu-west-1 after keys are created and verify deterministic runs using fixed KV seeds. Will attach sample prompts for their eval suite.
Sam (AE): Procurement Q: can we offer a one-time POC credit and a short SOW for a 2-week Dedicated eval? Who drafts the SOW?
Luca (Platform): Suggest language: "POC billed at standard rates; on conversion to Dedicated within 30 days, customer receives one-time credit equal to POC usage up to $X." I can draft a short technical SOW for the Dedicated eval (hardware, lead times, prewarm window).
Hana (Security): I'll attach the SOC2 excerpt and KMS integration pattern. If they need client-managed KMS in their tenant, we'll require an onboarding ticket and timeline.
infra-bot: ticket POC-VPC-310 opened by Luca for Photon Analytics.
Ivy (SE): I'll own the onboarding, smoke tests, and quickstart. Hana will own security questionnaire replies. Luca will handle infra sizing and the Dedicated SOW. Sam will coordinate kickoff with the customer.
Sam (AE): Thanks all. I'll schedule kickoff for tomorrow 09:00 CET and send the initial instructions to Photon. :thumbsup:
